title: Corruption-Robust Sparse Linear Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.37189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study sparse linear contextual bandits with knapsack constraints under joint reward and consumption corruption. Consumption corruption creates a challenge beyond corrupted rewards: it affects not only statistical estimates, but also the recorded budget, resource prices, and stopping decisions that govern future allocation. We develop Robust Optimistic Primal--Dual (ROPD), an estimator-modular framework that combines corruption-aware confidence widths with online resource prices and a budget-safety rule. With concrete sparse implementation, ROPD achieves regret against a clean population-LP benchmark of $\widetilde O(T^{2/3}+\Gamma T^{1/3})$ under forced exploration and population-design coverage, and $\widetilde O(\sqrt T+\Gamma)$ under on-policy realized-design coverage, for a supplied valid corruption bound $\Gamma$ under the stated proportional-budget scaling and fixed model/design parameters. translated_title: 背包约束下对腐坏鲁棒的稀疏线性上下文赌臂问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究在奖励与资源消耗同时受到腐坏（污染）情况下的带背包约束的稀疏线性上下文赌臂问题。消耗腐坏带来了超出奖励腐坏的挑战：它不仅影响统计估计，还会影响所记录的预算、资源价格以及决定未来资源分配的停止决策。我们提出了鲁棒乐观原始-对偶算法，这是一个估计器模块化框架，将感知腐坏的置信区间宽度与在线资源价格以及预算安全规则相结合。通过具体的稀疏实现，在给定有效腐坏上界Γ、所述按比例预算缩放以及固定模型/设计参数的条件下，ROPD相对于干净的总体线性规划基准，在强制探索与总体设计覆盖下取得 Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3}) 的遗憾，而在策略内实现设计覆盖下取得 Õ(√T+Γ) 的遗憾。当腐坏程度未知时，（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了鲁棒乐观原始-对偶框架ROPD，首次应对奖励与资源消耗同时被腐坏的带背包约束稀疏线性上下文赌臂问题，并通过感知腐坏的置信宽度、在线资源价格与预算安全规则的结合，在已知腐坏上界时取得Õ(√T+Γ)的遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes ROPD, a corruption-robust optimistic primal-dual framework for sparse linear contextual bandits with knapsack constraints under joint reward and consumption corruption, achieving Õ(√T+Γ) regret when a valid corruption bound is known.
